not_applicable.text: § 211.3 Definitions. The definitions set forth in § 210.3 of this chapter apply in this part.

items.statement: Have a quality control unit with the responsibility and authority to approve or reject all components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, packaging material, labeling and drug products.
items.quote: There shall be a quality control unit that shall have the responsibility and authority to approve or reject all components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, packaging material, labeling, and drug products

items.statement: Give the quality control unit authority to review production records to make sure no errors occurred or, if errors occurred, that they were fully investigated.
items.quote: the authority to review production records to assure that no errors have occurred or, if errors have occurred, that they have been fully investigated

items.statement: Make the quality control unit responsible for approving or rejecting drug products made, processed, packed or held under contract by another company.
items.quote: The quality control unit shall be responsible for approving or rejecting drug products manufactured, processed, packed, or held under contract by another company.
items.condition: products handled under contract by another company

items.statement: Make adequate laboratory facilities available to the quality control unit for testing and approving or rejecting components, drug product containers, closures, packaging materials, in-process materials and drug products.
items.quote: Adequate laboratory facilities for the testing and approval (or rejection) of components, drug product containers, closures, packaging materials, in-process materials, and drug products shall be available to the quality control unit.

items.statement: Make the quality control unit responsible for approving or rejecting every procedure or specification that affects the identity, strength, quality and purity of the drug product.
items.quote: The quality control unit shall have the responsibility for approving or rejecting all procedures or specifications impacting on the identity, strength, quality, and purity of the drug product.

items.statement: Document in writing the responsibilities and procedures that apply to the quality control unit.
items.quote: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit shall be in writing

items.statement: Follow the written procedures of the quality control unit.
items.quote: such written procedures shall be followed

items.statement: Ensure every person involved in manufacturing, processing, packing or holding a drug product has the education, training and experience, or a combination of these, needed to perform the assigned functions.
items.quote: Each person engaged in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall have education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof, to enable that person to perform the assigned functions.

items.statement: Train each employee in the specific operations they perform and in current good manufacturing practice, including the CGMP regulations and the written procedures they require, as these relate to the employee's functions.
items.quote: Training shall be in the particular operations that the employee performs and in current good manufacturing practice (including the current good manufacturing practice regulations in this chapter and written procedures required by these regulations) as they relate to the employee's functions.

items.statement: Have qualified individuals deliver CGMP training on a continuing basis, often enough that employees stay familiar with the CGMP requirements that apply to them.
items.quote: Training in current good manufacturing practice shall be conducted by qualified individuals on a continuing basis and with sufficient frequency to assure that employees remain familiar with CGMP requirements applicable to them.

items.statement: Ensure every person supervising manufacturing, processing, packing or holding of a drug product has the education, training and experience, or a combination of these, to perform their functions so as to assure the product has the safety, identity, strength, quality and purity it purports or is represented to have.
items.quote: Each person responsible for supervising the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall have the education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof, to perform assigned functions in such a manner as to provide assurance that the drug product has the safety, identity, strength, quality, and purity that it purports or is represented to possess.

items.statement: Have enough qualified personnel to perform and supervise the manufacturing, processing, packing or holding of each drug product.
items.quote: There shall be an adequate number of qualified personnel to perform and supervise the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of each drug product.

items.statement: Personnel involved in manufacturing, processing, packing or holding a drug product wear clean clothing suitable for their duties.
items.quote: Personnel engaged in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall wear clean clothing appropriate for the duties they perform.

items.statement: Wear protective apparel such as head, face, hand and arm coverings as needed to protect drug products from contamination.
items.quote: Protective apparel, such as head, face, hand, and arm coverings, shall be worn as necessary to protect drug products from contamination.
items.condition: as necessary to protect products from contamination

items.statement: Personnel practise good sanitation and health habits.
items.quote: Personnel shall practice good sanitation and health habits.

items.statement: Allow only personnel authorised by supervisors to enter areas of buildings and facilities designated as limited-access areas.
items.quote: Only personnel authorized by supervisory personnel shall enter those areas of the buildings and facilities designated as limited-access areas.

items.statement: Exclude anyone shown at any time, by medical examination or supervisory observation, to have an apparent illness or open lesions that may adversely affect drug product safety or quality from direct contact with components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials and drug products until the condition is corrected or competent medical personnel determine it does not jeopardise product safety or quality.
items.quote: Any person shown at any time (either by medical examination or supervisory observation) to have an apparent illness or open lesions that may adversely affect the safety or quality of drug products shall be excluded from direct contact with components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, and drug products until the condition is corrected or determined by competent medical personnel not to jeopardize the safety or quality of drug products.
items.condition: person shown to have apparent illness or open lesions

items.statement: Instruct all personnel to report to supervisors any health conditions that may adversely affect drug products.
items.quote: All personnel shall be instructed to report to supervisory personnel any health conditions that may have an adverse effect on drug products.
